name: Orca
where_agents_run: your machine + remote (SSH worktrees, Remote Orca Server (beta), headless `orca serve`, cloud VM (experimental)); phone companion (beta)
source_note: Re-checked 2026-09-30 against all 57 pages of onorca.dev/docs, the v1.4.217 release page, package.json and the repo home. Earlier: desktop and phone installed 2026-09-22, shipped app.asar read, memory measured on one PC.

multi_provider_supervision.value: 36 agents preset, plus any CLI agent

needs_you_signal.value: Hook-driven status, alerts, sound, unread bell

approve_deny_prompt.value: Approval cards in its beta chat view, desktop and phone

cross_provider_delegation.value: Workers on any agent, shown as child rows

conversation_gui_view.value: Experimental chat view over agent terminals

real_terminal.value: Embedded GPU terminal, splits, restored scrollback

session_organization.value: Worktree per task; experimental kanban dashboard

prompt_scratchpad.value: Unsent chat drafts kept; no separate drafts pad

saved_prompt_library.value: Quick Commands save agent prompts, synced to phone

builtin_editors_browser.value: Code and markdown editors, per-worktree browser

appearance_control.value: Themes, accent, UI and terminal fonts

usage_hud.value: Usage and resets for 8 agents, 80% warning chip

burn_rate_forecast.value: Usage and resets only; no forecast in docs

account_hotswap.value: Switch Codex and Claude accounts, no re-login

vault_task_source.value: Task sources are GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira only

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira issues to worktree to PR

worktree_management.value: Core: every task gets one, local or over SSH

planner_orchestrator.value: Orchestration runs, tasks and workers; off by default

knowledge_base.value: Leaves memory files to the agents; no store of its own

phone_no_new_app.value: Phone access is through its companion app

voice_input.value: Dictation on desktop (on-device models) and phone

download_size.value: v1.4.217: 193 MB Windows setup, 218-226 MB macOS dmg, 207-209 MB Linux AppImage

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Medium (estimate: Electron app plus a background process)

runs_in_terminal.value: Embeds its own GPU terminal instead

license_cost.value: MIT, free, uses your own subscriptions

extensibility.value: Plugins in beta; scriptable CLI, skills

stability_maturity.value: v1.4.217 (2026-09-29), daily builds; chat, plugins, mobile still beta
